candidates.title: Batch item transfer utility
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a utility for transferring batches of items between branches.
candidates.source_quote: I need a utility for transferring batches of items between branches.

candidates.title: Query builder for candidate selection
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a query builder to select candidate materials for transfer.
candidates.source_quote: Query for candidate materials

candidates.title: Reuse report query tool integration
candidates.statement: The system shall allow reuse or integration of the existing report query tool for candidate selection.
candidates.source_quote: we can reuse the report query tool for this

candidates.title: Save queries for repeated use
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to save queries for repeated use.
candidates.source_quote: Save queries for repeated use
candidates.priority_signals: The "save queries for repeated use" is crucial. We do this monthly

candidates.title: Share saved queries/templates
candidates.statement: The system shall allow saved queries to be shared among users or saved as report templates.
candidates.source_quote: Save/share queries - similar to report templates.

candidates.title: Manual selection from query results
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to manually select individual titles from query results (e.g., checkboxes) to include in a transfer.
candidates.source_quote: Manually select titles from query results
candidates.priority_signals: I also want to be able to MANUALLY SELECT from query results.

candidates.title: Batch update location field
candidates.statement: The system shall perform batch updates to change the location field on selected item records to the destination location.
candidates.source_quote: Batch update of location field - straightforward database update

candidates.title: Change records to move items
candidates.statement: The system shall change the records of selected items to move them to a new location.
candidates.source_quote: Change records of selected items to new location

candidates.title: Transaction safety for batch updates
candidates.statement: The system shall perform batch location updates within database transactions to ensure safety and consistency.
candidates.source_quote: transaction safety

candidates.title: Process updates in smaller batches
candidates.statement: The system shall process large batch updates in smaller chunks to avoid locking the database and to handle large collections efficiently.
candidates.source_quote: process in smaller batches to avoid locking the database
candidates.priority_signals: With 9.6 million items, batch updates need to be efficient.

candidates.title: Pull list generation
candidates.statement: The system shall generate printable pull lists listing items to be moved for physical retrieval.
candidates.source_quote: Pull list generation - create a printable list of items to be moved.

candidates.title: Printable transit labels / barcodes
candidates.statement: The system shall generate printable transit labels (including barcodes) for items being transferred.
candidates.source_quote: can we generate transit labels? Like, printable barcodes for the items being transferred?

candidates.title: Auto-revert after set period
candidates.statement: The system shall revert transferred items to their original location automatically after a configurable period of time.
candidates.source_quote: Revert items to original location after a set period of time
candidates.priority_signals: The "revert items to original location after a set period of time" is important for temporary transfers.

candidates.title: Auto-revert based on status or events
candidates.statement: The system shall support automatic reversion of transferred items based on other criteria such as changes in item status or defined events.
candidates.source_quote: revert items to original location after a set period of time and/or based on other criteria
candidates.priority_signals: Can we also revert "based on other criteria"?

candidates.title: Auto-revert when status 'sold'
candidates.statement: The system shall be able to revert or otherwise handle transferred items automatically when an item's status changes to "sold".
candidates.source_quote: if the item's status changes to "sold" at the book sale, automatically revert it?

candidates.title: Auto-revert when status 'returned'
candidates.statement: The system shall be able to revert transferred items when an item's status changes to "returned".
candidates.source_quote: Revert when item status changes to "returned" (event-based)

candidates.title: Suppress revert when checked out
candidates.statement: The system shall not revert an item automatically if it has been checked out at the destination; checked-out items should remain at the destination.
candidates.source_quote: when they're checked out there, they should stay. But if they just sit there unused, they come back.

candidates.title: Scheduled task for auto-revert
candidates.statement: The system shall implement an auto-revert mechanism via a scheduled task that checks transferred items and reverts them based on time or status criteria.
candidates.source_quote: Auto-revert mechanism - a scheduled task that checks transferred items and reverts them

candidates.title: Preview before making changes
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a preview before executing transfers, showing a confirmation message with the number of items and source and destination locations.
candidates.source_quote: "If you run this now, 25 items will be moved from Dalton-Whitman to Mobile Library Unit 3. Confirm?"

candidates.title: Undo function for transfers
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an undo function allowing recent transfer operations to be reverted by authorized users.
candidates.source_quote: And we need an undo function! What if someone clicks the wrong button?

candidates.title: Permission control for transfers
candidates.statement: The system shall limit the ability to initiate item transfers to authorized roles such as managers, administrators, or transfer coordinators.
candidates.source_quote: Not every staff member should be able to transfer items between branches. This should be limited to certain roles (managers, administrators, transfer coordinators).

candidates.title: Transfer history tracking
candidates.statement: The system shall track and store transfer history for each item, including count and timestamps, so users can view how many times and when an item has been transferred.
candidates.source_quote: Can we track transfer history? Like, "this item has been transferred 5 times in the past year."

candidates.title: Temporary transfers for events
candidates.statement: The system shall allow transferring items to a temporary location for a specific event or program and specify an end date to revert them after the event.
candidates.source_quote: transfer items to a temporary location for a specific event or program ... then revert them after the event.

candidates.title: Transfer delay / issue alerts
candidates.statement: The system shall provide alerts or notifications to specified users when a transfer is delayed or encounters issues.
candidates.source_quote: set up alerts? If an item transfer is delayed or has issues, notify me.

candidates.title: Logging and audit of transfers
candidates.statement: The system shall log all transfer actions and changes for audit purposes, recording who performed the transfer and when.
candidates.source_quote: Logging - track all transfers for audit purposes.

candidates.title: Scalability for large collections
candidates.statement: The system shall scale to efficiently handle batch transfer operations in environments with millions of items without causing excessive database locking or performance degradation.
candidates.source_quote: With 9.6 million items, batch updates need to be efficient.
candidates.priority_signals: With 9.6 million items, batch updates need to be efficient.
